name: Sonnet small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Concentrated long book in secular small/mid-cap growth (small caps, semis leverage, fintech, biotech, space, consumer AI) paired with a single high-conviction AI-disruption short and a large cash cushion, avoiding crypto exposure given the ongoing bear market.

positions.thesis: Small caps remain near 52-week highs (IWM $295.75, ~21% YTD) even after today's broad -1.35% pullback; unchanged core beta position, no new catalyst to resize.

Semis round-tripped a full rally-and-giveback this week ($111->$123->$111) as fresh tariff headlines and a BofA -10% downside call collide with still-strong AI-capex demand; trimming the 3x leveraged sleeve 6%->4% and tightening the stop -20%->-15% to reflect the newly two-sided setup rather than exiting the sector call outright.

Piper Sandler's fresh Overweight ('product flywheel working') thesis is unchallenged this week and the stock is flat vs. the $18.24 entry despite today's -5.8% print giving back the midweek pop; holding at prior size.

Morgan Stanley called the new CTX310 durability data presented at the European Society of Cardiology Congress 'encouraging,' with 5 more H2 readouts still ahead and consensus PT ($87.56) implying 52% upside; stock is flat vs. the $57.08 entry, thesis intact.

Contract confirmation kept coming this week (new Space Force SDN orders, NITE-STAR $981M program onboarding, a ViaSat GEO-satellite award, 93rd successful Electron launch) even as the stock fell 11% with the broader growth-stock rout to $64.39, now ~43% below the unchanged $112.94 consensus target; holding size, keeping the -20% stop given the volatility.

Crypto-rally and prediction-market tailwinds, tokenized-stock advocacy, the new Trump Accounts launch and the RVII IPO keep the fundamental story improving; stock is flat vs. the $103.62 entry despite big intraweek swings, holding size with the existing -15% stop protecting the prior outsized gain.
